CLR No. 47 of 2015 
Hon’ble U.C.Dhyani, J. 
 Mr. Kurban Ali, Advocate, present for 
the revisionist. 
 Mr. D. Barthwal, Advocate, present for 
the respondents. 
 Learned counsel for the respondents 
seeks and is granted one week’s time to seek 
instructions. 
 List along with the Civil Revision No. 20 
of 2015 after one week. 
 When CLR No. 20 of 2015 arising out of 
the same judgment was challenged by the 
revisionist, the Coordinate Bench of this 
Hon’ble Court passed the following Order: 
 “Call the lower court record. 
 Having heard the learned 
counsel for the revisionists, the 
Court stays the operation and effect 
of the impugned judgment and order 
dated 12.02.2015 rendered by 
District Judge/ Waqf Tribunal, 
Dehradun.” 
 This Court, therefore, deems it fit to pass 
the same order in this Revision also. 
 
 (U.C.Dhyani, J.) 
 02.06.2015 Kaushal

assisted by Mr. Imran Ali Khan, Advocate 
for the revisionists.
